items.title: 10.10 Electrolytic tareeqe se Avogadro's constant (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.10, printed page 223.

blocks.text: Avogadro constant, L, 1 mole mein maujood mukhtas (specified) particles (atoms, molecules ya ions) ki tadaad hai. Electrolysis ke tareeqe se 1 mole electrons ka charge nikal kar Avogadro constant ki value maloom ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.latex: L = \frac{\text{1 mole electrons ka charge}}{\text{1 electron ka charge}}
blocks.text_alt: L = 1 mole electrons ka charge / 1 electron ka charge

blocks.text: Electron ka charge tajurbe (experiment) se nikala ja sakta hai; yeh taqreeban 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 1 mole electrons ka kul charge = (electrons ki tadaad L) × (har electron ka charge). Is liye kul charge ko ek electron ke charge se taqseem (divide) karein to electrons ki tadaad, yani L, mil jati hai: 96500 / (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 6.0 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Agar 1 mole electrons ka charge 96500 C ho to L kitna banta hai?
blocks.explanation: L = 96500 / (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹) = 6.03 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, jo Avogadro ki maqbool value 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ ke bohat qareeb hai.

items: L = 1 mole mein particles ki tadaad.
L = (1 mole electrons ka charge) / (1 electron ka charge, 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).
